notes: Implemented scraper using sitemap index and news sitemap. Fetches each sitemap via polite_fetch, parses <loc> URLs, extracts date from URL path (YYYY/MM/DD) or falls back to <lastmod>. Filters to 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, deduplicates, writes TSV. Skips plain homepage entries. All HTTP requests succeeded (status 200). Verified sample articles (first 4 URLs) returned >120k chars and dates matched within 0 days. Per‑day counts printed, meeting required >=15 URLs for key dates.
